audiences.label: Researchers
audiences.intro: ORCID is a free, unique, persistent identifier (PID) for individuals to use as they engage in research, scholarship, and innovation activities. Learn how ORCID can help you spend more time conducting your research and less time managing it. [Learn more about ORCID for Researchers.](https://info.orcid.org/researchers)

features.title: Uniquely Yours
features.body: Distinguish yourself and claim credit for your work no matter how many people have your same (or similar) name. [Sign up here.](https://orcid.org/register)

features.title: Portable profile data
features.body: Easily share data between your record and funding, publications, data repositories, and other research workflows.

audiences.label: Universities & Research Institutes
audiences.intro: ORCID allows universities and research institutions to stay up to date with their researchers’ outputs, reduce administrative burden and input errors, and helps their researchers, post-docs, employees, and students improve the discoverability of their work. [Learn more about ORCID for Universities and Research Institutions.](https://info.orcid.org/orcid-for-universities-and-research-institutions/)

features.title: Support research productivity
features.body: Let your researchers spend more time on their research by reducing administrative burden

features.title: Track Careers
features.body: Track researchers’ and graduates’ careers after they leave your institution as well as collaborators and peers at other institutions.

audiences.label: Publishers
audiences.intro: Publishers that integrate with ORCID can streamline workflows for authors, editors, and reviewers alike. ORCID improves the overall value of books and journals to the community, helping ensure that publishers have greater retention of authors and readers. [Learn more about ORCID for Publishers.](https://info.orcid.org/orcid-for-publishers/)

features.title: Know your authors
features.body: Better know who your authors, co-authors, and reviewers are and improve the integrity of your submission, review, and reporting processes.

features.title: Portable profile data
features.body: Easily share data between your record and funding, publications, data repositories, and other research workflows.

audiences.label: Vendors & Service Providers
audiences.intro: Vendors and service providers that connect their services to the ORCID Registry join our ecosystem of over 5,000 ORCID-integrated systems. Providing this service increases the value they provide to the scholarly community with authoritative, high-quality profile data. [Learn more about ORCID for Vendors and Service Providers.](https://info.orcid.org/vendors-and-service-providers/)

features.title: Increase ROI

featuredNews.title: Researchers: Learn What Your ORCID Record Can Do For You
featuredNews.body: Managing your research across different systems, institutions, and stages of your career can be exhausting. ORCID is here for you—across your career, disciplines, and borders—helping researchers maintain a trusted, connected research identity and leaving them with more time for research. Once you make verified connections with institutions you trust and work with, you can allow them to add data about you. You can also use your ID to sign into other systems, autofill forms, and sync your data across platforms. [Watch this short video to learn more about what your ORCID record can do for you](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1rZvFGLe7bg).

integrate.title: Integrate with ORCID for a Stronger, more Robust Research Ecosystem

paragraphs.body: From employment affiliations, research outputs, funding, peer review activity, research resources, and more, ORCID connects people with their research activities. [Discover ORCID’s workflows and integrations](https://info.orcid.org/documentation/).

Find ORCID-enabled scholarly service providers, including Grant/Facility Application Management Systems, Manuscript Submission Systems, Repository Systems, Research Information Systems, and Discovery Systems. [View our full list of certified CSPs](https://info.orcid.org/vendors-and-service-providers/orcid-certified-service-providers-list/).

Getting started with ORCID is easier than it might seem. [Read our ORCID for Researchers page](https://info.orcid.org/researchers/) to learn answers to common questions and [register for an ORCID record today](https://orcid.org/signin).
